A tiling is unique if it has no flips (2x2 areas covered by two dominoes). To make a tiling $T$ unique, we must break every flip by marking cells from the alternative dominoes of that flip. For the all-horizontal tiling, the flip graph consists of $n/2$ disjoint path graphs, each with $n$ vertices and $n-1$ edges. The minimum vertex cover of such a path graph is $\lceil n/2 \rceil$. Thus, for $n=194$, the number of dominoes needed is $(194/2) \times (194/2) = 97 \times 97 = 9409$. Each domino contains 2 cells, so $k = 9409 \times 2 = 18818$.
